images.intro: Choose a photo provider. Changing the selection does not start a download.
images.legacyHelp: Automatic mode continues using local providers until you save a new selection.
images.externalHelp: Connect an already running ComfyUI server. This option does not install it.
images.managedHelp: The bundled setup supports Windows with an NVIDIA GPU. For other GPUs, choose sd.cpp Vulkan or cloud.
images.sdcppHelp: CUDA12 is recommended for NVIDIA; Vulkan for other GPUs. Valid CLI installations are reused.
images.tokenPresent: A token is available on the server. Fill this field only to replace it.
images.tokenAbsent: No Cloudflare token is available on the server.
images.cloudHelp: Use your own Cloudflare account. The token stays in the backend and this field clears when submitted.
images.cloudFixed: FLUX.2 Klein 9B: one 1024×1024 image and four fixed steps. Local presets do not control cloud output.
images.cloudUpload: The prompt and one character reference are sent to Cloudflare. The reference is resized to at most 480 pixels without modifying the original. Charges and free allocation depend on your account.
images.notGenerated: This check does not create an image; generation has not been tested.
images.setupHelp: Review files, sizes, and licenses before downloading. Valid installations are not downloaded again.
images.pending: Waiting for the photo job to finish
images.retryHelp: Review setup again to resume. Partial downloads can be reused.
images.privacyCloud: PAP sends the prompt and one character reference to api.cloudflare.com. Tokens stay in the backend.
app.title: Amika settings
app.hostOnly: Open settings on the host computer.
settings.chatHelp: Choose the provider and model for conversations with Amika.
settings.voiceHelp: Configure Amika's voice and the language she hears.
settings.visionHelp: Choose the model for understanding camera and shared-screen images.
settings.imagesHelp: Choose a photo provider, check the connection, and review local setup.
settings.memoryHelp: Manage Amika's memories, search conversations, and check local storage.
settings.providersHelp: Save service connections, then select their providers in feature settings.
settings.languageHelp: Choose the language for the settings interface.
settings.statusHelp: Check feature readiness and connection warnings.
settings.setupHelp: Set up Amika step by step. Save each section before continuing.
confirm.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Discard them and continue?
provider.title: Providers
provider.keyHelp: The key is sent only when saved, then cleared. A server environment key takes precedence.
provider.deleteKey: Delete stored credentials when changing service origin
slot.title: Provider roles
tts.fishVoiceHelp: Leave blank to use the configured default Fish voice.
tts.elevenEmotionTags: Use emotion tags for Eleven v3
tts.elevenHelp: Paste a Voice ID from ElevenLabs. Flash/Turbo uses clean text; speed is 0.7–1.2. Replies remain visible if speech fails.
tts.elevenV3Help: Eleven v3 uses stability 0, 0.5, or 1. Tags follow speech emotion, then avatar emotion; similarity and speed are not sent.
tts.selectionHelp: Automatic mode chooses a Fish emotion for each coherent speech segment, separately from its avatar expression. The mappings below are fallbacks when a segment has no valid speech emotion; fixed messages always use them. This choice works independently of spoken style.
tts.earlyFirstSentence: Speak the first complete sentence sooner
tts.sentencePauseHelp: Default: 200 ms. Sentence and segment pauses use the longer gap, without adding them together.
privacy.reaction: Conversation and visual descriptions → quick reaction
slot.conversationRolesHelp: Quick reaction and reflection follow the chat model by default. Assign a fast model to quick reaction for lower latency; using the same model may take longer.
tts.neutralExperimental: The gentle, warm tag for netral is experimental; compare its sound with a core tag.
tts.maxChars: Maximum characters in a merged sentence group
tts.debugHelp: Diagnostics include spoken text and tags. Audio and credentials are never recorded.
tts.emotionPresetsHelp: Choose up to two Fish tags for each avatar emotion. These are fallbacks in automatic mode and the primary tags in mapped mode. Basic and Advanced presets share the same sentence tag limit.
test.slow: First response exceeded the selected threshold.
test.missingModels: Models unavailable ({code}); enter the model manually.
warning.http: HTTP/WS traffic is unencrypted. Use only a trusted local or private network service.
warning.plaintext: Keys are stored without encryption because plaintext storage was explicitly enabled.
warning.secretStorage: Secret storage could not be read. Check Diagnostics before saving credentials.
warning.recovered: Corrupt settings were backed up and reset. Review the current provider assignments.
warning.windowsFirst: Windows-first: a native encrypted store is unavailable here. Use server environment keys or explicitly opt into plaintext.
warning.credentials: This JSON appears to contain credentials. Values will be stored as secrets; the field is cleared after submission.
warning.preset: The maintainer must verify this example endpoint before release.
privacy.intro: The following data is sent when its feature is used. Hosts come from current settings.
diagnostics.help: Uses a temporary random value in a separate folder; does not alter your keys.
diagnostics.acl: Windows ACLs have not been inspected. Keep the local directory private to your account.
diagnostics.readOnly: Environment storage is read-only; a write test is unavailable.
wizard.title: First-run setup
wizard.finished: Setup complete. You can change connections at any time.
wizard.chatRequired: Assign a chat provider and model to continue.
confirm.delete: Delete provider {id}? Its assigned roles will be unassigned.
confirm.origin: Delete old credentials and switch to the new service origin?
error.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere. Reload before saving again.
error.origin: Service origin changed. Enter a replacement key or confirm deletion of old credentials.
error.inUse: This provider is still assigned to a role.
error.forbidden: Access denied. Open settings on the host computer and reload.
error.auth: Check the key and service permissions.
error.rate: Too many requests. Wait one minute.
error.timeout: The deadline expired. Check connectivity or increase the test deadline.
error.lockBusy: Another writer is active or its lock is recent. Wait and retry.
error.lockUnknown: Lock ownership is unknown. Stop other writers and inspect the lock locally.
error.lockRecovery: Lock recovery is active or interrupted. Retry; if it persists, stop all writers and inspect the recovery guard locally.
error.readOnly: Secret storage is read-only. Use server environment variables.
error.invalid: Check fields, JSON, URL and numeric bounds.
error.network: The server could not be reached.
error.generic: The operation failed. Check the code and provider status.
privacy.routing: Messages, recent conversation, and relevant visual descriptions for routing
privacy.memoryWriter: Completed dialogue for evidence-backed fact extraction
privacy.memoryEmbedding: Dialogue and search queries for local semantic memory search
memory.intro: Memory retains completed dialogue and attributed evidence across sessions. Private instructions, images, audio and interrupted replies are excluded.
memory.retention: Dialogue and memories remain on this device until you explicitly delete them.
memory.managed: Start the installed embedding service with the application
memory.deviceAuto: Automatic: CUDA when available, otherwise CPU
memory.deviceCpu: CPU: use system RAM instead of VRAM
memory.setupHelp: Use the following CLI commands to review and explicitly install BGE-M3. Python 3.11+ is required; model weights are about 2.3 GB.
memory.setupNoDownload: Saving settings or starting the app never downloads the model. The setup command handles installation; the app uses cached files only.
memory.query: What would you like to recall?
memory.manualHelp: Manual facts are labelled separately from facts verified against original user quotes.
memory.confirmReindex: Rebuild vectors for retained dialogue and facts? Keyword search remains available while processing runs.
memory.deleteHelp: Deleting a fact also removes its supporting dialogue and dependent memories. Deleted evidence cannot return through pending jobs or old migration backups.
memory.confirmClear: Delete all retained dialogue, facts, episodes, indexes, jobs and owned migration backups? This cannot be undone.
memory.confirmDelete: Delete this record and its evidence? This removes {events} dialogue events, {facts} facts and {episodes} episodes, plus related indexes and jobs.
memory.legacy: Legacy record: no original quote available
memory.ready: The local embedding service is ready.
memory.external: Using an already running local embedding service.
memory.offline: Semantic embeddings are unavailable; keyword search remains active.
memory.notInstalled: BGE-M3 is not installed. Review and run the explicit setup command.
memory.failed: The local embedding service needs attention.
memory.keywordFallback: Recall waits at most 300 ms for query embeddings, then continues with keyword search.
memory.actionableFailure: Run memory:doctor, check the configured local service and cached installation, then retry startup.
memory.jobError: Processing stopped with code {code}. Review configuration before retrying.
memory.providerHelp: Use the local BGE embedding adapter and bge-m3-d768 model. Chat-only providers cannot produce memory vectors.
memory.reindexRequired: The embedding model or index is incompatible. Rebuild the semantic index; keyword search remains available.
memory.writerUnavailable: The memory writer is unavailable; original dialogue remains stored and jobs wait for a configured writer.
memory.storageUnavailable: Memory storage is unavailable. Inspect it locally; existing files have not been reset.
memory.indexPending: The semantic index is being prepared. Original dialogue is already searchable by keyword.
